description: Labelled queries for evaluating evidence retrieval. Written by the project author, so labels reflect one person's judgement. Policy: a passage is relevant when it covers the main subject of the query. 'expected' lists acceptable passage ids; an empty list means no passage in the collection addresses the subject. 'borderline' marks cases where the label is debatable. Queries paraphrase facts in news style and deliberately avoid copying passage wording. Split into dev (threshold tuning) and test (final report) by md5 of the query, see app/ml/retrieval_eval.py.
